note: Rates below are those in force on the research date. Gross and in-hand figures shown on this site are estimates built from these rules. They exclude income tax, arrears, and post-specific allowances unless stated.

central-7cpc.label: Central Government, 7th CPC pay matrix
central-7cpc.payCommission: 7th Central Pay Commission (in force since 1 Jan 2016). The 8th CPC was constituted with Terms of Reference notified on 3 Nov 2025; it has 18 months to report and no revised pay is in force yet.
central-7cpc.daNote: DA raised from 58% to 60% w.e.f. 1 Jan 2026 (Cabinet, 18 Apr 2026). The 1 Jul 2026 instalment had not been announced as of 17 Oct 2026.

hra.label: Y class city (e.g. Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Warangal, Mysuru)

central-7cpc.hraNote: HRA moved to 30/20/10% from 1 Jan 2024 when DA reached 50%. Not paid if government quarters are allotted.
central-7cpc.transportNote: DA is also paid on Transport Allowance. Higher TPTA cities include Hyderabad and Bengaluru.
central-7cpc.pension: NPS for those joining on or after 1 Jan 2004: employee 10% of (Basic + DA), Government 14%. Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) is an option under NPS from 1 Apr 2025: assured payout of 50% of average basic pay of the last 12 months for 25 years of qualifying service, proportionate down to a 10 year minimum.

otherDeductions.name: CGEGIS
otherDeductions.detail: Group A Rs 120, Group B Rs 60, Group C Rs 30 per month

otherDeductions.name: CGHS
otherDeductions.detail: Only in CGHS cities. Rs 250 (Levels 1 to 5), 450 (Level 6), 650 (Levels 7 to 11), 1000 (Level 12 and above) per month

otherDeductions.name: Professional tax
otherDeductions.detail: Levied by the state where posted (AP, Telangana, Karnataka: Rs 200 per month at these salary levels)

central-7cpc.increment: 3% of basic pay once a year on 1 January or 1 July, rounded to the nearest 100 (moves one cell down the pay matrix level).

sources.title: Cabinet approves additional instalment of DA w.e.f. 01.01.2026

ap-rps-2022.label: Andhra Pradesh, Revised Pay Scales 2022 (11th PRC)
ap-rps-2022.payCommission: AP RPS 2022 (G.O.Ms.No.1, Finance, 17 Jan 2022): master scale Rs 20,000 to Rs 1,79,000. Notional from 1 Jul 2018, monetary benefit from 1 Apr 2020. A 12th PRC has been set up; its revision is not in force.
ap-rps-2022.daNote: G.O.Ms.No.119 and 120 (11 Sep 2026) raised DA from 37.31% to 40.04% (from 1 Jul 2024) and to 41.86% (from 1 Jan 2025). Paid in cash from the September 2026 salary. Figures from secondary reports of the GOs.

hra.label: District headquarters and cities above 2 lakh population

ap-rps-2022.hraNote: Modified HRA order of Feb 2022, effective 1 Jan 2022. The ceiling for the 10% slab was not confirmed from the GO text.
ap-rps-2022.transportNote: No general transport allowance; conveyance allowances apply only to specific posts.
ap-rps-2022.pension: Employees joining after 1 Sep 2004 are under the Contributory Pension Scheme (CPS, linked to NPS): employee 10% of (Basic + DA). The AP Guaranteed Pension Scheme Act, 2023 exists; its implementation status was not verified.

otherDeductions.name: APGLI
otherDeductions.detail: Compulsory state life insurance, slab by pay

otherDeductions.name: Professional tax
otherDeductions.detail: Rs 200 per month above Rs 20,000 gross

ap-rps-2022.increment: Annual increment = next stage in the master scale segment for the post.

sources.title: Pay Scales RPS 2022 Circular Memo
sources.publisher: Finance Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh

sources.title: AP issues modified order on benefits under revised pay scales (HRA slabs)

ts-rps-2020.label: Telangana, Revised Pay Scales 2020 (1st PRC)
ts-rps-2020.payCommission: Telangana RPS 2020 (G.O.Ms.No.51, 11 Jun 2021): master scale Rs 19,000 to Rs 1,62,070, 30% fitment. The 2nd Telangana PRC report is not implemented as of the research date.
ts-rps-2020.daNote: G.O.Ms.No.128 and 130 (6 Oct 2026) sanctioned 37.31% from 1 Jan 2024 and 40.04% from 1 Jul 2024, paid with the October 2026 salary. Figures from secondary reports of the GOs.

hra.label: Cities above 2 lakh (e.g. Warangal, Karimnagar, Khammam, Nizamabad)
Towns of 50,000 to 2 lakh, and district headquarters

ts-rps-2020.hraNote: RPS 2020 HRA order (G.O.Ms.No.53 of 11 Jun 2021, per secondary copy). No ceiling. One secondary copy prints 25% for Greater Hyderabad; the PRC recommended 24%.
ts-rps-2020.pension: Contributory Pension Scheme for those joining after 1 Sep 2004: employee 10% of (Basic + DA).

otherDeductions.name: TSGLI
otherDeductions.detail: Compulsory state life insurance, slab by pay

otherDeductions.name: Employees Health Scheme
otherDeductions.detail: Contribution announced in 2026 (reported Rs 500 per month); verify with your DDO

otherDeductions.name: Professional tax
otherDeductions.detail: Rs 200 per month above Rs 20,000 gross

ts-rps-2020.increment: Annual increment = next stage in the master scale segment for the post.

sources.title: Telangana G.O.Ms.No.51 (2021), Revised Pay Scales 2020
sources.publisher: Government of Telangana (copy on CAG site)

ka-7spc.label: Karnataka, 2024 Revised Pay Scales (7th State Pay Commission)
ka-7spc.payCommission: Karnataka 7th SPC (chair K. Sudhakar Rao), implemented from 1 Aug 2024 by Finance Department order FD 21 SRP 2024 (23 Aug 2024). Minimum basic Rs 27,000, maximum Rs 2,41,200. DA of 31% merged and 27.5% fitment added to pay as on 1 Jul 2022.
ka-7spc.daNote: Raised from 14.25% to 15.75% w.e.f. 1 Jan 2026 (Finance Department order, May 2026). DA restarted from a low base because DA was merged into pay in 2024.
ka-7spc.hraNote: HRA percentages under the 2024 scales could not be confirmed from an official order. Bengaluru is the only Category A city. Enter your HRA rate manually in the calculator.
ka-7spc.pension: National Pension System for those joining on or after 1 Apr 2006: employee 10% of (Basic + DA), Government 14%. Restoration of the old pension scheme has been discussed; no general change was verified.

otherDeductions.name: KGID
otherDeductions.detail: Compulsory Karnataka Government Insurance, slab by pay

otherDeductions.name: Professional tax
otherDeductions.detail: Rs 200 per month from Rs 25,000 gross (Rs 300 in February)

ka-7spc.increment: Annual increment by the fixed stage amount of the pay scale.

sources.title: Karnataka implements 7th Pay Commission (minimum Rs 27,000, maximum Rs 2,41,200)

bank-12bps.label: Public sector banks, 12th Bipartite Settlement
bank-12bps.payCommission: 12th Bipartite Settlement / Joint Note (8 Mar 2024), effective 1 Nov 2022. Officers: JMGS-I starting basic Rs 48,480. Clerks: starting basic Rs 24,050.
bank-12bps.daNote: Bank DA changes every quarter with the CPI. It is not modelled here; use the gross pay printed in the notification.
bank-12bps.hraNote: Bank HRA is a percentage of basic that depends on the centre; check the notification.
bank-12bps.pension: NPS for those joining after 1 Apr 2010.
bank-12bps.increment: Stage-wise increments fixed in the settlement.

sources.title: IBA 12th Bipartite Settlement and Joint Note

defence-7cpc.label: Armed Forces, 7th CPC pay matrix (defence)
defence-7cpc.payCommission: 7th Central Pay Commission (in force since 1 Jan 2016). The 8th CPC was constituted with Terms of Reference notified on 3 Nov 2025; it has 18 months to report and no revised pay is in force yet.
defence-7cpc.daNote: DA raised from 58% to 60% w.e.f. 1 Jan 2026 (Cabinet, 18 Apr 2026). The 1 Jul 2026 instalment had not been announced as of 17 Oct 2026. For the armed forces, DA is also paid on Military Service Pay.

hra.label: Y class city (e.g. Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Warangal, Mysuru)

defence-7cpc.hraNote: HRA moved to 30/20/10% from 1 Jan 2024 when DA reached 50%. Not paid if government quarters are allotted. Officers in field areas or with service accommodation do not draw HRA.
defence-7cpc.transportNote: DA is also paid on Transport Allowance. Higher TPTA cities include Hyderabad and Bengaluru.
defence-7cpc.pension: Armed forces personnel are outside the National Pension System and remain under the defined-benefit defence pension rules. Officers contribute to the Armed Forces Personnel Provident Fund (a savings fund) and the service insurance scheme.

otherDeductions.name: AFPP Fund
otherDeductions.detail: Provident fund subscription chosen by the officer (savings, not tax)

otherDeductions.name: Group insurance (AGIF / NGIS / AFGIS)
otherDeductions.detail: Monthly premium of the service insurance fund

defence-7cpc.increment: 3% of basic pay once a year on 1 January or 1 July, rounded to the nearest 100 (moves one cell down the pay matrix level).
